_note: Screening block: sex items only, sharing no item with the cards, the survey or the 12 statements. Keying and vignette fairness are DEMO values set by the builder, not pre-tested; P1 replaces them.

text.en: Women and men are equally able to manage a large team.
text.hinglish: Mahila aur purush ek badi team sambhalne mein barabar kaabil hain.

text.en: Some jobs simply suit men better than women.
text.hinglish: Kuch jobs purush ke liye mahila se behtar baithti hain.

text.en: Employers should check that women and men are treated alike when they apply for jobs.
text.hinglish: Naukri ke liye apply karte time employers ko dekhna chahiye ki mahila aur purush ke saath ek jaisa behaviour ho.

text.en: A firm has one opening for a senior project manager. Two applicants, a woman and a man, have the same experience and the same interview scores. The woman has a young child. What is the fairest way to decide?
text.hinglish: Ek firm mein senior project manager ki ek hi post khaali hai. 2 applicants, ek mahila aur ek purush, ka experience aur interview ke marks barabar hain. Mahila ka ek chhota bachcha hai. Decide karne ka sabse fair tareeka kya hai?

text.en: Give the role to the woman, because women have fewer chances at senior jobs.
text.hinglish: Post mahila ko do, kyunki mahila ko senior jobs ke mauke kam milte hain.

text.en: Treat them the same and decide with a further task set for both under the same conditions.
text.hinglish: Dono ke saath ek jaisa behaviour karo aur dono ke liye ek hi conditions mein ek aur task rakhkar decide karo.

text.en: Give the role to the man, because he is less likely to need leave.
text.hinglish: Post purush ko do, kyunki use chhutti ki zarurat kam padegi.

text.en: Decide by a coin toss, since the two cannot be separated.
text.hinglish: Sikka uchhalkar decide karo, kyunki dono mein koi fark nahin kiya ja sakta.

text.en: Men and women should share the care of children and elders equally, including taking leave.
text.hinglish: Bachchon aur buzurgon ki dekhbhal mein purush aur mahila ko barabar hissa lena chahiye, chhutti lena bhi shamil hai.

text.en: A man is a more natural boss than a woman.
text.hinglish: Boss banne ke liye purush mahila se zyada natural hota hai.

text.en: Companies should take active steps to bring more women into senior posts.
text.hinglish: Companies ko senior posts par zyada mahilaon ko laane ke liye active kadam uthane chahiye.

text.en: In a team meeting, a woman suggests a plan and nobody responds. Ten minutes later a man suggests the same plan and the manager praises him. What is the fairest response by the manager afterwards?
text.hinglish: Team meeting mein ek mahila ek plan batati hai aur koi jawab nahin deta. 10 minute baad ek purush wahi plan batata hai aur manager uski taarif karta hai. Baad mein manager ka sabse fair response kya hoga?

text.en: Give the credit to the man, since men usually have the good plans.
text.hinglish: Credit purush ko do, kyunki achhe plans aksar purush ke paas hote hain.

text.en: Thank both for their input and give them shared credit.
text.hinglish: Dono ko unke input ke liye shukriya kaho aur credit dono ko barabar do.

text.en: Note that the woman suggested the plan first and give her the credit.
text.hinglish: Yeh note karo ki plan pehle mahila ne bataya tha aur credit use do.

text.en: Give the credit to the man, since the manager heard it clearly from him.
text.hinglish: Credit purush ko do, kyunki manager ne yeh baat usi se saaf suni.

text.en: Women are better suited than men to jobs that mainly involve caring for people.
text.hinglish: Jin jobs mein zyadatar logon ki dekhbhal karni hoti hai, unke liye mahila purush se zyada suitable hai.

text.en: Women lose interest in their careers once they have children.
text.hinglish: Bachche hone ke baad mahilayein apne career mein dilchaspi kho deti hain.
